entries.title: Quiz shows right answers and questions due again
entries.body: Each quiz question, in the margin and in the Learn panel, shows where you stand: a pale green tick once answered, a deeper green when it was judged right on this visit, and faded with a clock when you answered it three or more days ago. A faded question opens with an empty box, says how long ago you answered, and offers a button to show your earlier answer. The panel opens at the first question you have not answered or are due to recall.

entries.title: Structure can be run again on its own
entries.body: You can run Structure again from the AI processing list under Metadata, or with Structure › Run again in the command bar. Both warn that the article's paragraph labels go missing until they are rewritten. With Experimental features on, a Start this article again command takes you to the existing reset controls.

entries.title: Feedback box keeps up on very long articles
entries.body: On a very long article, typing in the Feedback box and pressing Send could lag noticeably. Both respond faster. Opening and closing the box is unchanged.

entries.title: Arc stays in step with a re-run Structure
entries.body: When Structure was run again and divided the article differently, the Arc could go on showing sentences written for the old layout, with some silently missing. Those out-of-date sentences are no longer shown, on your own articles or on shared ones; on your own, the Arc can then be written afresh.
